title: area_list
description: Ranked areas of one kind within a district or local body, from GET /areas/{kind}?within=<id>&limit=<n>. Each item is a stored ward_scores row, returned as stored: withheld scores stay null with their reason, counts always show. Order: areas with at least one shown score first, lowest mean of the shown scores first; then the rest; ties go to more verified reports, then area id. An empty list (total 0) when no area of that kind has a site there yet.

within.description: The district id (rajasthan-jodhpur) or local body id (jodhpur-mc) the areas lie in, as asked.

limit.description: The limit applied: 50 by default, capped at 200.

areas.description: At most limit items. Each item is a full ward_scores body; validate it against ward_scores.schema.json (schemas here never reference each other).
